candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex — Czech-language official texts of EU financial-services law (CELEX by document)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative, legally binding Czech-language version of every EU regulation/directive that binds Czechia (PSD2, IPR 2024/886, DORA 2022/2554, MiCA 2023/1114, AMLR 2024/1624). Carries entry-into-force and date-of-application articles verbatim, plus consolidated versions and corrigenda that shift deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CELLAR SPARQL endpoint or EUR-Lex web services; fallback stable CELEX URL pattern https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/CS/TXT/?uri=CELEX:3YYYYRNNNN; parse 'Datum použitelnosti' metadata field
queries_used: EUR-Lex nařízení o okamžitých platbách české znění použitelnost 2024/886

candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex — Official Journal L series, daily editions (CS)
candidates.why_relevant: The moment of publication in the OJ starts every EU deadline clock. Daily L-series monitoring is the earliest reliable trigger for new delegated/implementing regulations (RTS/ITS) under PSD2, DORA, MiCA and the IPR.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily OJ RSS/webservice poll filtered on DG FISMA subject codes and on keywords (platební, kryptoaktiva, provozní odolnost)
queries_used: EUR-Lex nařízení o okamžitých platbách české znění použitelnost 2024/886

candidates.source_name: ČNB — Obecné pokyny evropských orgánů dohledu (ESA guidelines + ČNB compliance statements)
candidates.why_relevant: This is the single most important CZ-specific artefact in this cell: for each EBA/ESMA/EIOPA guideline, ČNB publishes a 'Sdělení ČNB' stating whether it complies, from which date, and to which supervised entities it applies. It is the national bridge between an EU soft-law text and a binding CZ supervisory expectation.
candidates.source_subtype: regulator legislative base / compliance notices index
candidates.legal_status: public sector information, ČNB terms of use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the index page, diff the list of 'Sdělení ČNB o obecných pokynech ...' items; each item page carries EBA/GL reference + ČNB applicability date; attached CS PDFs of the guideline itself
queries_used: EBA obecné pokyny české znění ČNB dodržování compliance table

candidates.source_name: ČNB — DORA: Digitální provozní odolnost finančního trhu (thematic hub)
candidates.why_relevant: ČNB's national landing page for Regulation (EU) 2022/2554: scope in CZ, reporting obligations, register of information submission deadlines, webinars and slide decks that state exactly what CZ entities must file and when.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page + linked /export/sites/cnb/... PDF gallery crawl; watch the SDAT DORA reporting sub-site for taxonomy/deadline changes
queries_used: DORA nařízení 2022/2554 účinnost povinnosti finanční subjekty ČNB dohled

candidates.source_name: ČNB — MiCA / působnost ČNB podle nařízení o trzích kryptoaktiv
candidates.why_relevant: States how Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 lands in CZ via zákon č. 31/2025 Sb. o digitalizaci finančního trhu (effective 15 Feb 2025), which ČNB powers apply from when, and tracks the first CASP authorisations — i.e. EU rule to CZ application date and enforcement reality.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll ČNB 'Novinky v dohledu' and press-release feeds filtered on MiCA / kryptoaktiva
queries_used: ČNB MiCA nařízení kryptoaktiva zákon o digitalizaci finančního trhu účinnost

candidates.source_name: ČNB — Co nového v dohledu / Novinky (supervisory news feed)
candidates.why_relevant: Fast-moving pointer stream: first place ČNB signals a new EU-derived obligation, a changed reporting deadline, a joint statement, or an ESA guideline it intends to comply with. Ideal snowball feed into all the direct sources in this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML diff / RSS if available; classify each item by EU instrument mentioned
queries_used: DORA nařízení 2022/2554 účinnost povinnosti finanční subjekty ČNB dohled

candidates.source_name: ISAP — Informační systém pro aproximaci práva (Úřad vlády ČR)
candidates.why_relevant: The government's own EU-to-CZ implementation tracker: assigns the responsible ministry ('gestor') for each EU act, records transposition method, transposition deadline, and compatibility of draft CZ law with the EU act. This is precisely where an EU deadline becomes a Czech legislative task, and it covers acts long before ČNB says anything.
candidates.access_status: open (public section); some views may require session handling
candidates.legal_status: public sector information (zákon č. 106/1999 Sb. regime)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the public 'Data pro veřejnost' Domino views by CELEX; scrape gestor + transposition deadline fields; note Lotus Notes URL patterns are brittle
candidates.discovered_via_method: inferred category (who must publish transposition status) then cs query
queries_used: ISAP databáze transpozice evropské legislativy vláda ČR isap.vlada.cz

candidates.source_name: EBA — Regulation and policy / Single Rulebook (incl. Interactive Single Rulebook and Q&A)
candidates.why_relevant: Source of the level-2/level-3 material (RTS, ITS, guidelines, Q&As) that determines what PSD2/PSR, DORA and AMLR actually require operationally. EBA publishes guidelines in all EU languages including CS, and the Q&A answers are what CZ-supervised PSPs are held to.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the publications listing with document-type filters (Guidelines / Final Report / Consultation Paper); capture 'applies from' dates; pull the CS language attachment where present
queries_used: EBA interactive single rulebook consultation paper deadline register

candidates.source_name: EBA — Compliance tables for guidelines (national competent authority compliance status)
candidates.why_relevant: For each guideline EBA publishes a compliance table naming which NCAs comply / intend to comply / do not comply, and from when. This is the EU-side mirror of the ČNB 'Sdělení' and lets you detect CZ divergence or delay without waiting for ČNB.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the compliance-table attachment on each guideline's publication page; parse the CZ/ČNB row. Exact index URL not confirmed in this pass — resolve from the guideline page rather than guessing a path.
queries_used: EBA interactive single rulebook consultation paper deadline register
EBA guidelines compliance table Czech National Bank

candidates.source_name: EBA — Consultations / public hearings (open consultation register)
candidates.why_relevant: Earliest visibility of future binding technical standards under PSR/PSD3, DORA and AMLR — typically 2-3 months of comment window, with the final text landing 6-12 months later. Gives lead time no CZ-only source offers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the EBA publications listing filtered to 'Consultation paper'; the exact consultations URL path was not confirmed in this pass, so resolve via site search rather than assuming.
queries_used: EBA interactive single rulebook consultation paper deadline register

candidates.source_name: EBA — Payment Institutions Register (PSD2) and Credit Institutions Register (EUCLID)
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level consolidated register fed by ČNB notifications; lets you see CZ-authorised PSPs/EMIs and their passporting footprint (~199 CZ entries reported), and detect authorisation-regime changes as PSD3/PSR re-license the population.
candidates.legal_status: EU reuse policy; data quality caveats acknowledged by EBA
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic bulk file download, filter country=CZ, diff snapshots; cross-check against the ČNB national register (seznam regulovaných subjektů)
queries_used: EBA register payment institutions credit institutions EUCLID public register Czech

candidates.source_name: European Commission — Have Your Say (public consultations & feedback portal)
candidates.why_relevant: Upstream of everything else in this cell: call-for-evidence and consultation windows (4-12 weeks) for PSD3/PSR follow-ups, retail payments, digital euro, AML implementing acts. Available in CS interface for many initiatives, and CZ stakeholder submissions are published, revealing national positions.
candidates.legal_status: EU reuse policy; published feedback is public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll initiative listing filtered by DG FISMA topic; capture open/close dates and CZ-origin feedback entries
queries_used: Have Your Say European Commission consultations financial services feedback period

candidates.source_name: European Commission DG FISMA — banking and finance regulation pages
candidates.why_relevant: Owner of PSD3/PSR, IPR and the AML package; publishes the political-agreement announcements, adopted delegated acts and application-date explainers that fix the timetable CZ entities must plan against.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: News + 'law' section crawl; join each item to its CELEX for the CS text
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Have Your Say result
queries_used: Have Your Say European Commission consultations financial services feedback period

candidates.source_name: ECB — Instant Payments Regulation / retail payments pages
candidates.why_relevant: Explains IPR obligations and their staggered dates, including the distinct, later timetable for non-euro-area Member States such as Czechia (euro instant payments obligation for CZ banks reported from July 2027, euro payments from koruna accounts from June 2028). That CZ-specific offset is the single most consequential deadline in this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page monitoring + TIPS documentation release notes; corroborate every date against the CS text of Reg. 2024/886 rather than the explainer
queries_used: ECB TARGET Instant Payment Settlement TIPS Czech koruna CNB SEPA instant payments requirements

candidates.source_name: ČNB — CERTIS / okamžité platby (instant payments) pages
candidates.why_relevant: The CZ national counterpart to the IPR: CERTIS is the domestic instant-payment rail, and ČNB has publicly reasoned about not joining TIPS. Changes here signal how Czechia will actually meet the EU euro-instant obligation (correspondent access vs. direct TIPS participation).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page monitoring in cs; EN mirror exists at /en/payments/certis/instant-payments/ — the cs slug should be resolved from ČNB navigation rather than assumed
queries_used: ECB TARGET Instant Payment Settlement TIPS Czech koruna CNB SEPA instant payments requirements

candidates.source_name: FAÚ (Finanční analytický úřad) — AML balíček / AML nařízení section
candidates.why_relevant: The CZ FIU is the national authority for the EU AML package. Its AMLR/AMLD6 pages carry the Czech reading of Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 and its 10 July 2027 application date, plus methodological guidance banks and PSPs will be judged against.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the 'legislativa a metodika' rozcestník; diff methodological instructions and AMLR sub-pages
queries_used: ČNB legislativní základna evropská legislativa přehled AMLR nařízení AMLA 2024/1624

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR — Finanční trh / konzultační materiály
candidates.why_relevant: MF ČR is the gestor for transposing EU financial-services directives (PSD3, AMLD6) and runs national consultation rounds ('konzultační materiál') on how to exercise Member State options. It authored zákon o digitalizaci finančního trhu (31/2025 Sb.) implementing MiCA/DORA. This is where the CZ national application choices are decided.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor tiskové zprávy + financni-trh subsections; harvest 'Konzultační materiál' PDFs under /assets/; note domain appears in both mfcr.cz and mf.gov.cz forms
queries_used: Ministerstvo financí ČR konzultace veřejné konzultace finanční trh evropská regulace platební styk

candidates.source_name: NÚKIB — cybersecurity authority statements on DORA/NIS2 overlap for financial entities
candidates.why_relevant: DORA (EU) meets the CZ zákon o kybernetické bezpečnosti (NIS2 transposition). ČNB and NÚKIB have issued a joint interpretation of which obligations apply to DORA entities under ZKB — a CZ-only resolution of an EU-law boundary question that no EU source contains.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll aktuality feed with filter on 'finanční', 'DORA', 'ZKB'; pair with the ČNB-hosted joint statement PDF
queries_used: DORA nařízení 2022/2554 účinnost povinnosti finanční subjekty ČNB dohled

candidates.source_name: ČNB — Legislativní základna (supervision legal base index)
candidates.why_relevant: Master index over ČNB's mapping of EU acts to CZ supervisory practice: ESA guidelines, digital operational resilience, Q&As, úřední sdělení. Best single crawl root for discovering new EU-origin obligation pages before they are announced elsewhere.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Recursive crawl of the legislativni-zakladna subtree plus the /export/sites/cnb/.../galleries/ PDF stores
candidates.discovered_via_method: URL-path snowball from ČNB sdělení results
queries_used: EBA obecné pokyny české znění ČNB dodržování compliance table

candidates.why_relevant: Fast, Czech-language interpretation of what an EU act means for CZ-supervised entities, often naming the expected CZ implementing statute and dates weeks before official CZ material appears. Useful as an early-warning and terminology layer; must never be treated as authority for a date.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; quote sparingly, link rather than reproduce
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/newsletter subscription; use only as a lead generator, then verify against EUR-Lex CS text or ČNB

candidates.source_name: International law-firm PSD3/PSR trackers (Norton Rose Fulbright, Morrison Foerster, Freshfields, HSF Kramer, Worldline)
candidates.why_relevant: PSD3/PSR is still pre-publication; these trackers are currently the most granular public reconstruction of the trilogue outcome, scope and the entry-into-force + 18/21-month application arithmetic that will determine the CZ deadline. Replace with EUR-Lex CS text the moment the OJ publication lands.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watchlist of specific publication pages; treat dates as provisional until CELEX exists

candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex — Legislative summaries in Czech (souhrny právních předpisů EU)
candidates.why_relevant: Official Commission-authored plain-Czech summaries of SEPA/payments and other acts. Excellent for building the CZ glossary (nařízení, směrnice, úhrada, inkaso, poskytovatel platebních služeb) and for quickly scoping an act before reading the binding text.
candidates.legal_status: EU reuse; summaries are explicitly non-binding
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch legissum: URIs alongside each CELEX; use for terminology extraction only

candidates.source_name: ČNB SDAT — reporting platform, DORA register-of-information section
candidates.why_relevant: Where the abstract EU obligation becomes a dated filing: taxonomies, submission windows and technical specifications for the DORA register of information that CZ financial entities must send to ČNB. Deadline changes surface here first and are machine-checkable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the documentation/taxonomy file listing and version numbers; do not attempt authenticated areas

negative_findings.description: No single official CZ or EU page was found that consolidates 'EU act -> Czech application date' for the payments/digital-finance file. ČNB publishes per-instrument pages, ISAP tracks transposition per CELEX, EUR-Lex holds the article text — but the join has to be constructed by the collector.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in cs and en returned per-instrument pages only; no CZ regulatory calendar/timeline artefact surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deliverable of this cell (a CZ-binding deadline timetable) cannot be scraped from one place; it must be assembled from EUR-Lex CS + ČNB sdělení + ISAP, which raises collection cost and makes date-conflict reconciliation a design requirement.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language version of EBA consultation papers or EBA compliance tables was found. EBA consults and publishes compliance tables in English only; only final guidelines get CS translations, and those appear with a lag via ČNB.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs queries for 'EBA konzultace' style terms returned only ČNB sdělení pages and CS PDFs of already-final guidelines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any monitoring confined to Czech-language sources structurally misses the 2-3 month consultation window — the only period in which the eventual CZ obligation can still be influenced or anticipated.

negative_findings.description: The canonical index URLs for (a) the EBA consultation-paper register and (b) the EBA guideline compliance tables were not pinned down in this pass; only the parent Single Rulebook and generic search pages were confirmed in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned Single Rulebook, ISRB and Q&A pages but not a stable consultations/compliance-tables index path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These two are high-value for the cell; a verification pass should resolve them via eba.europa.eu site navigation rather than guessing paths, to avoid recording a fabricated or stale URL.

negative_findings.description: PSD3/PSR has no CELEX identifier or Czech official text yet — reporting indicates provisional political agreement (late 2025) with OJ publication expected during 2026 and application roughly 18-21 months later.
negative_findings.result_summary: All PSD3/PSR timeline detail found was secondary (law firms, Worldline), not primary EU text.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Every PSD3/PSR date currently in circulation is provisional. The source plan must include a trigger that switches from commentary to EUR-Lex CS the day the OJ publication appears, or the intelligence product will carry unsourced dates.

negative_findings.description: The Czech-language ČNB CERTIS instant-payments URL slug was not directly confirmed; only the English mirror (/en/payments/certis/instant-payments/) appeared in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: EN pages confirmed; CS equivalent inferred from ČNB's consistent cs/en mirroring but not observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recorded as inferred, not verified — the liveness pass should resolve the cs slug from ČNB navigation.

coverage_gaps.description: ESMA and EIOPA were not scouted in this pass even though they co-issue guidelines that ČNB adopts via the same 'Sdělení ČNB' mechanism (relevant to MiCA on the ESMA side, and to bancassurance distribution).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add esma.europa.eu (MiCA technical standards, Q&A, consultations) and the ESMA registers to the source set; the ČNB obecné pokyny index already covers the CZ-side adoption notices for both.

coverage_gaps.description: EU legislative-process trackers (EP Legislative Observatory / OEIL, Council public register, Interinstitutional file numbers) were not scouted. These carry trilogue documents and adoption dates months before EUR-Lex publication.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout oeil.secure.europarl.europa.eu and consilium.europa.eu public document register for the PSD3/PSR and AMLA files; they are the only primary sources for pre-publication timing.

coverage_gaps.description: Industry scheme-level rulebooks (European Payments Council SCT Inst rulebook, Verification of Payee scheme rules) were not scouted. IPR compliance for CZ banks is executed through EPC scheme deadlines, not only through the Regulation's own dates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add europeanpaymentscouncil.eu rulebook release calendar and the Czech Banking Association (ČBA) position pages as the CZ industry-side mirror.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech-language coverage is strong for national adoption artefacts (ČNB, MF, FAÚ, ISAP) but thin for EU-origin consultation and pre-legislative material, which is English-only in practice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design the collection plan as two-tier: English for upstream (consultations, trilogue, EBA level 2/3), Czech for the binding downstream (EUR-Lex CS, ČNB sdělení, Sbírka zákonů). Do not expect cs coverage upstream.

coverage_gaps.description: The Czech national statute-book layer (Sbírka zákonů / e-Sbírka, zákon č. 31/2025 Sb. and 32/2025 Sb.) was identified only indirectly through ČNB and MF pages, not scouted as a source in its own right.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout e-sbirka.cz / zakonyprolidi.cz as the authoritative CZ text layer where EU regulations are given national sanctioning and effect dates; assign to a CZ-domain cell to avoid duplicating this cell's EU-origin focus.

brief: For EU-origin rules binding Czechia, the source landscape splits cleanly into three layers: EUR-Lex (binding Czech-language text and the date-of-application article), the EU rule-makers (Commission/DG FISMA, EBA, ECB) who own the level-2/level-3 detail and the consultation windows, and the Czech adoption layer (ČNB legislativní základna and its per-guideline 'Sdělení ČNB', ISAP transposition tracking, MF ČR as transposition gestor, FAÚ for the AML package, NÚKIB for the DORA/NIS2 boundary). The highest-value and most distinctly Czech artefacts are the ČNB compliance statements on ESA guidelines and the ISAP gestor/transposition records — neither has an EU-level equivalent, and both convert a soft EU text into a dated national supervisory expectation. Upstream signal is English-only in practice: EBA consultation papers, compliance tables and trilogue material have no Czech version, so a cs-only watch would systematically miss deadlines while they are still forming. Two dates dominate the current cycle and should anchor collection: the non-euro-area instant-payments timetable for CZ (reported July 2027 for euro instant payments, June 2028 for euro payments from koruna accounts) and AMLR application on 10 July 2027, with PSD3/PSR still pre-publication and therefore currently sourceable only from secondary commentary.
